sections.title: Health Education Theories, Service Learning Practice, & Policy
sections.description: This service-learning course trains students to provide culturally relevant health education in community health settings. The course will explore the structural implications of inequities on health behaviors, intersectionality as it applies to wellness, and health education policy in Philadelphia. Students can apply the health education modalities explored in this course to multiple settings, including schools, clinics, and community-based programming. In the first half of the course, students will use the empowerment model to design, implement, and evaluate health education workshops at a partner school or partner organization. Community, education, and clinical leaders will share their expertise and provide feedback for students on their workshops. After refining their workshops, students will develop lessons learned and policy recommendations. This is an Academically-Based Community Service (ABCS) course.
